propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the prod instance id and region needed for operators to perform SSM operations, forcing them to guess.
The AWS region (us-east-1) is single-sourced in terraform (var.aws_region default and versions.tf backend) but not documented in the operational runbook.
The runbook must clearly document the instance id, region, account number, and SSM connect commands (start-session and send-command) in a reference section.
The autodeploy self-update behavior is misunderstood: the script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync, but script-only changes require hand-deployment because they do not trigger an automatic rsync.
The installer (install-autodeploy.sh) and systemd unit files are excluded from in-run re-materialization to prevent self-modification races and always require hand-deployment.
